sub_indicators.label: Power outages a month
sub_indicators.subject: infra.energy
sub_indicators.text: Grid reliability: power outages a month
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's single electricity market and Continental Power System Master Plan ask for secure, reliable and affordable electricity across the continent. They set no outage figure.
criteria: The latest count, for 2023 or later, is more than ten power outages a month.

The power goes off ten times a month or fewer, in the latest count for 2023 or later: the regulator's or utility's interruption frequency divided by 12 where one is published, otherwise the outages firms report in the World Bank's Enterprise Surveys.
Five times a month or fewer.
Once a month or less. A count of grid collapses, hours of load shedding or how long outages last is never used at any stage.
